snippet.title: Donna Survivors - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A cute and chaotic survivors-like action game set in the world of Donna! Play as lovable characters, combine wild abilities, defeat bosses, and survive hordes of enemies across 6 unique maps.

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4300000/Donna_Survivors/
